questions.question: In a psalm David wrote while he was sick, who does he call blessed?

answers.text: The one who cares for the poor
The one who gives at the temple
The one who keeps every feast

questions.question: In a psalm where David asks the LORD to heal him, he tells the LORD he has sinned against Him. True or false?
In a psalm about his sickness, David says someone has lifted up his heel against him. Who is it?
At the end of a psalm written in sickness, where does David say the LORD will set him?

answers.text: On his throne for many years
